issue.body:
```
from starlette.exceptions import HTTPException
import pickle
# Works:
pickle.loads(pickle.dumps(HTTPException(404)))
# Breaks:
pickle.loads(pickle.dumps(HTTPException(status_code=404)))
```
The following error gets thrown:
```
TypeError: __init__() missing 1 required positional argument: 'status_code'
```
issue.title: HTTPException pickle fails when constructed using named parameter status_code
